page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.48xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high vCPU count and the 2.0 GB per core memory ratio, this instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads. It is highly suited for high-performance computing, batch processing, large-scale scientific modeling, and distributed analytics. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, offering high compute density for workloads that do not require local storage or massive memory-to-core ratios.
